summary: No MCP tool may change tailnet state without an explicit confirmation: tailscale_execute returns the planned request for every state-changing endpoint unless called with confirm=true (only policy validate, policy preview, and AWS external-id validate are exempt POSTs), and import is hidden from the Cobra mirror.
reason: execute reaches the whole-set route replace (POST /device/{id}/routes) and the whole-policy write (POST /tailnet/{tailnet}/acl), which drop routes or comments when an agent sends a partial object, and the Cobra mirror shells out without --agent, so the mirrored import would POST every record unconfirmed; the CLI already requires --yes for these writes.
validated_outcome: tailscale_execute_confirm_test.go: unconfirmed device.routes.set and device.delete send nothing and return a plan without credentials; confirm=true sends exactly one request; reads and acl validate need no confirm; TestMCPWriteSurfaceIsGatedOrLocal fails if import or any other non-read-only tool outside the local-store and confirm-gated set is registered.
